preconditions.description: n is divisible by 5, and all inputs are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upToi <= b and 0 <= quantityi <= n for upToi, quantityi in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint's upToi is within [1, b] and quantityi is within [0, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'fair' if and only if there exists a set S of size n with distinct positive integers in [1, b] such that: (1) for each r in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}, exactly n//5 elements of S are congruent to r mod 5, and (2) for each hint (upToi, quantityi), exactly quantityi elements of S are in [1, upToi]
postconditions.description: Output 'fair' if and only if a valid set S exists satisfying all constraints (mod 5 distribution and hint counts).
